text:
deploy-bot: deploybot: initiating staged rollout v3.12.0 -> eu-west1 at 5% (change window 18:00-19:00 UTC). release notes: https://redwood.app/releases/3.12.0 

maria (eng-release): starting the 5% canary now. pls watch latency, 5xx, and KV cache metrics. ping here with quick signals.

jack (sre): watching. seeing a small bump in 500s on edge-proxy in eu-west1, started ~18:02 UTC, currently +0.3% vs baseline. might be noise.

sam (backend): i pushed a couple of sample traces to the trace service — looks like KV cache misses on some long tail requests. links: http://int.logs/trace/abc123

maria (eng-release): propose we HOLD at 5% for 20m while triage happens. what's the rollback/gating plan if errors continue?

devon (infra): recommend pinning canary traffic to a small subset of nodes and disabling burst autoscale for the window. i'll patch the cluster: `traffic.pin = true` and `autoscale.burst = false`.

deploy-bot: ``redwood deploy --version v3.12.0 --staged 5% --region eu-west1``
deploybot: status: rolling -> 5% applied to canary pool (instance ids: i-0a1b2c, i-0d3e4f).

jack (sre): p95 latency +120ms over baseline in the canary pool; error rate trending up to 0.6% over the last 3m.

ivy (pm): quick question — any data migrations or stateful changes with this release? if we rollback will there be fallout for persisted data?

sam (backend): no migrations, inference runtime only. rollback is safe from a data-consistency POV.

maria (eng-release): stop/go proposal: PAUSE at 5% for 30m while infra/dev triage KV misses. rollback criteria: if error rate > 0.5% for 10m, rollback to v3.11.4. vote in thread (+1 = agree).

jack (sre): +1 to pause and triage.

devon (infra): opening infra ticket IR-5929, will pin nodes now. ETA ~8m.

ops-bot: alert: healthcheck flapping detected on canary pool in eu-west1 at 18:09 UTC; automated fallback triggered for 2 instances.

sam (backend): given the alert, i'd prefer rollback unless we can find clear mitigations in the next 5m.

maria (eng-release): DECISION: HOLD rollout at 5% (stop). increase paused. rollback will be initiated automatically if error rate > 0.7% sustained for 5m OR manual rollback by owners if root cause indicates systemic failure. devon and sam own triage. release-notes link pinned above.

deploy-bot: acknowledgement: pausing further traffic increases for v3.12.0 in eu-west1. command: `redwood rollout pause --version v3.12.0 --region eu-west1`

jack (sre): collecting logs and traces now, dumping artifacts to http://int.artifacts/ir-5929/ . i will post a short summary in 10m.

maria (eng-release): thanks all — keep updates short here. if we get safe signals we'll resume bump from 5% -> 20% after a green 30m window.

sam (backend): quick note — cheap mitigation to try: increase KV cache TTL for canary nodes to 60s, will push as a config toggle if infra gives the go.

devon (infra): confirmed, pin applied. holding autoscale. go ahead and push TTL toggle to canary namespace only if you think it helps.

jack (sre): last check before triage: error rate 0.62%, p95 +115ms. saving current metrics snapshot at 18:12 UTC.
